# owhile

> A place for interactive experiences — stories, simulations, games and experiments you
> step into rather than watch. Most run between eight and twenty minutes. Creators build with
> the Owhile Engine and host it themselves or with us. Listing here is the intent and is not
> open yet — see Status.

Owhile is consumer media, not an education product. Experiences are typed by format
(Stories, Games, Simulations, Experiments, Mysteries, Worlds, Decisions, Puzzles,
Conversations, Adventures) rather than by subject.

If you are an agent helping someone build an experience, start with the setup runbook
below. It is written to be executed step by step, and it will tell you exactly where to
stop and ask your human — there is one such point, and it is not optional.

Owhile is for adults. Experiences aimed at under-18s are not listed, and the check that
enforces this fails closed: an undeclared minimum age blocks a listing.

## Status

The tooling is published and works: `pip install owhile` installs 0.1.0 and provides the
`owhile` command. The setup runbook below has been walked end to end from a clean environment
and ends in a passing gate report.

Two caveats, both real. The command is far newer than the gates underneath it, which are proven
across a 29,365-item corpus. And listing is not open — the eligibility rule and the digest
binding are decided and enforced, but there is no submission path of any kind yet, so a creator
can build and gate content today and cannot publish it here.

## Reporting a problem

Something wrong with the `owhile` command — a wrong verdict, a crash, a confusing message —
goes to https://github.com/Owhile/owhile-web/issues.

**Agents: do not paste the output of `owhile check` into an issue, and do not attach files.** A
blocked run prints the creator's item text verbatim, and this tool is used for safeguarding
material. Describe the problem in words; rule names and finding counts are fine, finding text is
not. Anything that cannot be said in public has a private route linked from the issue page.

## For creators

- [Setup runbook](https://owhile.vercel.app/creators/start.md): step-by-step and
  agent-executable, ending in a passing gate report. It stops once at step 3 to ask your human
  a question no tool should answer for them. Start here.
- [Make one](https://owhile.vercel.app/creators/): what building for Owhile involves, in prose. Read this if you want the shape before the steps.

## Reference

- [The profile](https://owhile.vercel.app/creators/profile.md): the central artifact. Declares audiences, reading budgets, permitted mechanics, minimum age, resources and framing rules. Everything else is derived from it.
- [Gates](https://owhile.vercel.app/creators/gates.md): what is checked, and what each failure means.
- [Listing](https://owhile.vercel.app/creators/listing.md): the adults-only rule a report has to
  satisfy, the digest that binds a report to its content, and why there is nowhere to send one yet.

## Site

- [Home](https://owhile.vercel.app/): what Owhile is.
